summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases. On June 2, 2026, it bought 7,500,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 100.2609 pence per share (range 99.12-101.40 pence). The buybacks are part of a program announced January 30, 2026, with shares to be cancelled. No board recommendation or advisors noted. The purchase reduces share count and boosts EPS. Watch for continuation of the buyback cadence and potential impact on capital ratios under UK MAR.
